Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: Roomavie home organization article cover and editorial photograph
Primary request: Create a highly realistic compact home living area with a previously busy console or dresser now styled with only one lamp, one small tray and one decorative object, leaving most of the surface visibly empty. Show an ordinary small home with realistic furniture, warm natural light and no luxury architecture. No people, no text, vertical editorial photograph.
Scene: a lived-in small apartment, warm oak closed-storage console, soft cream walls and a glimpse of a modest linen sofa. The single decorative object can be a ceramic vase. Let the console's clear surface and open surrounding floor make the practical visual-clutter reset immediately legible.
Composition: vertical portrait, natural eye-level camera, important furniture and objects around the middle of the frame so a landscape crop can also work as a blog cover. Real material textures and believable proportions.
Constraints: no people, no text, no signage, no logos, no watermark, no collage, no before/after split; no extravagant architecture or excessive decorative objects.
